cohort: The study included 324 children aged between 6 months and 5 years, with 160 cases diagnosed with CNLDO and 164 healthy controls.
finding: A positive family history of CNLDO, birth weight <=2500g, and maternal age <=27 years at delivery were significantly associated with an increased risk of congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction (CNLDO).
mod_finding: There was no significant relationship found between the mode of delivery and the development of congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction (CNLDO).
